title: Incoming entry screenshots (cruise missile arriving from the north-east)

Missile damage is attributed to the launching building, on the same map and across maps
Interceptors turn after the ascent toward the incoming bearing (missile entry heading, pod landing cell, world meeting point) and fly out of the map
